value.description: Find protocol documentation in API v1

value.text:
The codebase documents two protocols for serving the API.

Connect RPC is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`. Its wrapping logic lives in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`. gRPC-Gateway is registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`.

The generated gRPC-Gateway wrapper is in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`.

q19.

Connect — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (registration via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler` in `RegisterConnectHandlers`), `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (wrapping: `ConnectServiceHandler` MemoService methods delegate to `APIV1Service`)

gRPC-Gateway — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (registration via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`), `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go` (generated REST/JSON gateway handlers wrapping the gRPC server interface)
